title: An Act to Regulate the Use of Prior Authorization for Health Care Provider Services
committee_name: Health Coverage, Insurance and Financial Services

summary.text:
This bill is a concept draft pursuant to Joint Rule 208.

This bill proposes to regulate the use of prior authorization for health care provider services.

status_label: Ought Not to Pass Pursuant To Joint Rule 310

final_disposition.label: Ought Not to Pass Pursuant To Joint Rule 310
